title: Kodansha House Hosts The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity Creator Saka Mikami in NYC
content: Kodansha USA Publishing announced on Thursday that it will host manga creator Saka Mikami ( The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity ) at its Kodansha House pop-up event in New York City on October 10 and October 11. The event will return from October 9 to October 18 at 508 West 37th Street.
author: ANN

title: Uta Macross Rhythm Game Launches Project for Offline Version
content: AUGUST Inc. announced on Friday it is developing Uta Macross , a "revival" version of the Macross franchise's first rhythm game Uta Macross : Smartphone De Culture , for a planned release on iOS, Android, and Steam next spring.
author: ANN

title: Sorry, Zoro Fans, But One Piece Just Confirmed Luffy’s New Strongest Partner
content: The One Piece manga is continuing its latest arc, and as it depicts a major battle against the King of the World, it has also introduced a companion of Luffy who could take Zoro’s place as the new strongest partner for the Straw Hat.

title: Bleach’s Final Season Brings Back Fan-Favorites for New Scenes Ahead of Anime’s Grand Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is now in its final slate of episodes, and the final season of the anime has brought back some missing fan-favorite faces for some brand new moments ahead of the grand finale.

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run Confirms New Release Schedule for 2026 Netflix Return With New Look
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run is on its way back to Netflix later this month with both its 2nd and 3rd Stages, and it has confirmed its new release schedule with a new preview showing off more to come in the new episodes.

title: Sword Art Online Material 1: Sugary Days Tops Oricon's Monthly Light Novel Ranking for August 2026
content: Writer Reki Kawahara and artist abec 's Sword Art Online Material 1: Sugary Days novel ranked at #1 with 27,284 copies. Kadokawa published the novel on August 7. The new novel depicts Kirito and Asuna's life as newlyweds.

title: Crunchyroll Hidden Gem Isekai Confirms Release Date for Season 3 Return – Watch Trailer
content: A hidden gem Isekai anime series now streaming with Crunchyroll is coming back later this month with its third season, and the anime has confirmed its release date with a new trailer showing it all off.

title: Kingdom Manga Tops Oricon's Monthly Comic Ranking for August 2026
content: The 80th volume of Yasuhisa Hara 's long-running Kingdom manga topped the chart, selling 365,379 copies. The volume shipped in Japan on August 19. Viz Media began releasing the manga in English last November. The 40th volume of Muneyuki Kaneshiro and Yūsuke Nomura 's Blue Lock manga ranked at #2.
author: ANN

title: Hunter x Hunter Goes Back on Shonen Jump Hiatus After Big Return
content: Hunter x Hunter is officially going back on hiatus after returning for new chapters this Summer, and unfortunately it stings all the more thanks to a big return in the final chapter before its big break.
